description: STAGE-CONSISTENCY BASELINE for saga #811 (issue #816 item 5): the `check()` half of a pair whose `-execute` sibling is a CHARACTERIZATION fixture. This half is ALREADY CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix UNCHANGED — it is precisely the answer the run path never consults, which is the whole of saga #811's shape-A mechanism. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. The `wait` form, with `interaction-events` active so `wait` itself resolves and only the genuine fault on `wibble` is reported. `turtle-rendering` is deliberately absent from the declared set: this source contains no turtle word, and a `check` fixture's `profiles` array is what is actually handed to `check()`, so it states the minimum the assertion needs.
